key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens and closes the bar.

key.name: max-results
key.description: How many results the bar shows at most.

key.name: open-on-monitor
key.description: Open on the monitor with the pointer, or always on the primary monitor.

key.name: remember-query
key.description: Reopen with the previous search text, selected so typing replaces it.

key.name: search-apps
key.description: Include applications in the default search.

key.name: search-windows
key.description: Include open windows in the default search.

key.name: search-calculator
key.description: Answer math expressions and unit conversions in the default search.

key.name: search-currency
key.description: Convert currencies ("$20 in eur") with daily exchange rates fetched from open.er-api.com and cached for 12 hours.

key.name: search-settings
key.description: Include GNOME Settings panels (Wi-Fi, Displays, …) in the default search.

key.name: search-commands
key.description: Include system and custom commands in the default search.

key.name: search-files
key.description: Include the best file and project matches in the default search.

key.name: default-file-results
key.summary: File results in the default search
key.description: How many file results to add to the default search.

key.name: web-fallback
key.description: End the default search with "Search the web for …", and open typed URLs.

key.name: default-search-engine
key.description: Key of the web shortcut used for the web search fallback (e.g. g, ddg).

key.name: ask-ai-apps
key.description: Offer "Ask Claude" / "Ask ChatGPT" for installed AI desktop apps.

key.name: clipboard-history
key.description: Remember text you copy for the /clip search. Kept in memory only and cleared on logout.

key.name: clipboard-history-size
key.description: How many copied texts to remember.

key.name: learn-choices
key.description: Rank results you pick often higher for what you typed. Stored only on this computer.

key.name: clear-learning
key.description: Changing this value (from the settings button) clears what was learned.

key.name: search-drives
key.description: Include files on mounted drives and USB sticks in @ search, using a file list kept in ~/.cache/ask-bar.

key.name: recent-files-count
key.description: How many recent files a bare "@" shows.

key.name: index-projects
key.description: Scan the home folder for git repositories, which GNOME's file index skips.

key.name: project-scan-depth
key.description: How many folder levels below home to look for git repositories.

key.name: panel-width
key.description: Width of the bar in pixels.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Distance of the bar from the top of the screen, in percent of its height.

key.name: dim-background
key.description: Darken the rest of the screen while the bar is open.

key.name: compact-mode
key.description: Smaller rows without descriptions.

key.name: show-footer
key.description: Show keyboard hints at the bottom of the bar.

key.name: animations
key.description: Animate the bar when it opens.

key.name: pinned-favorites
key.description: Ordered JSON list of pinned app, file, project and command references.

key.name: custom-commands
key.description: JSON list of {"name": "...", "command": "..."} run with sh -c from the "/" mode.

key.name: custom-web-shortcuts
key.description: JSON list of {"key": "...", "name": "...", "url": "...%s..."} used with "!key".
